utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — the repair drive is still Sunday at the community center. I’m splitting folks by task and spreading the word, so if anything changes Hana’ll let us know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help sort the donations and label the boxes for the repair drive. Just let me know what time to be there Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Sam — come by Sunday at the community center, and I’ll have you on donations and box labels.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep an eye out for the update once you’re back. Good luck with the errands, and I’ll tell Quinn we’re still moving on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Oren — I’ll check for Quinn’s update while I’m out and let you know when I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll hold the line here and keep Quinn posted. Safe errands, Ira!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive, and if I hear any more details, I’ll pass them along. Sounds like Uli is keeping it low-key and handling the rest.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate you spreading the word. If you hear a start date, let me know and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — if I hear a start date, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday at the community center works for me. If you can swing by late and help sort donations quietly, I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll swing by late and help sort the donations quietly. I’ll leave the rest to you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. If you can also keep an eye out for tape and any spare screws, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’ll start with the broken door and the leaky faucet, then handle the smaller fixes after. That’s the clearest way to keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Oren’s on the door and faucet, right? And Rosa’s still keeping the list updated?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Oren has the door and faucet first, and Opal’s keeping an eye on any changes. We’ll keep the list straight and move to the smaller fixes after that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got my drill, hammer, wrench sets, duct tape, and ladder ready for the repair drive. If you need the ladder or the rest of the tools, I can bring them by 4 this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, Gus — thanks. The drive’s Sunday at the community center, and if I spot anything needing fixing, I’ll pass it along to Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Bo — just let me or Rosa know what turns up, and I’ll have the ladder and the rest by 4 if needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can look for the tape and spare screws for the repair drive. Gus said he can lend a wrench set and duct tape, too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Rey — I’ll let Cleo know to set those aside, and I’ll make sure Pia gets the repair drive details. If you find any working wire too, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll keep an eye out for any working wire as well. Thanks for passing it on to Cleo and Pia.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The repair drive’s Sunday at the community center. I’m still keeping an eye out for a wrench set, duct tape, and a ladder.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — I’ll keep tracking where the repair drive items get dropped off and picked up. If anything moves, I’ll note exactly where it ends up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal. Let me know if you spot the wrench set, duct tape, or ladder.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to come by, but I’d really like the timing and drop-off details confirmed first. Once that’s set, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and for drop-offs and pickups, Bo’s using the porch at 14 Maple. If you want, I can also keep you posted on anything else that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — I’ll plan for Sunday at the community center and the porch at 14 Maple. Please let me know if anything else changes before then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word and let folks know what’s changing. Noah, keep me posted and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep you posted if anything changes. I’m a bit scattered today, so I might miss a detail or two.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, Noah — I’ll help keep the updates straight and pass them along. Just send me whatever you have, and I’ll keep everyone posted on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can ask Gus to bring his tools around 4 if Hana says we need the ladder. Have you heard back from Hana yet?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet — I’m still waiting on Hana. If the ladder’s needed, let Mina know and I’ll keep track of the tape, spare screws, and any working wire.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, I’ll wait for Hana’s call. If she says yes, I’ll bring the ladder and ask Gus to come by around 4.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t confirmed the repair drive yet. Rey can look for tape and spare screws, and if we need it, Mina can bring a ladder.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Right, and Bo’s still using the porch at 14 Maple for any drop-offs and pickups. I’ll pass along anything solid if I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I’ll wait for confirmation before I act. If anything changes, let me know and I’ll keep the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure everyone stays posted on the repair drive plan.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik. I’m still on the lookout for a wrench set, duct tape, and a ladder at Sunday’s community center repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Bo — I’ll come by a bit late, but I’ll help sort the tools and see what still needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’m starting with the broken door and the leaky faucet, then I’ll get to the smaller fixes. And if Ira’s update comes in, make sure I get it as soon as they’re back.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll pass along Ira’s update as soon as they’re back. And I’ll keep an eye out for any wire or supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Noah — that helps a lot. If you spot tape or spare screws too, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sunday at the community center, right? I’ll keep an eye out for tape or spare screws on the porch at 14 Maple and send Rosa anything else that needs fixing on the block.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, Sunday at the community center works. I’ll sort the donations and label the boxes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out and let Rosa know if I spot anything on the block.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t confirmed the repair drive yet, but Rey can look for tape and spare screws. If we still need it, Mina can bring a ladder too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks — Sunday at the community center is still the plan, and I’ll keep splitting folks by task. Let me know if anything changes, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll confirm the repair drive and check whether Rey still needs a wrench set or duct tape. If the ladder comes up, I’ll let Mina know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I heard it’s a low-key neighborhood repair drive for little fixes like loose hinges and leaky faucets. Quinn’s spreading the word, and Gus is bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can look for tape and spare screws. If you still need wire, I’ll ask around quietly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great—quietly asking around would help a lot. Uli wants to keep it low-key, so tape, spare screws, and any wire would fit right in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll join late and keep it low-key. Let me know once Hana confirms the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — the repair drive is still Sunday at the community center, and I’ll let you know if any items move or where they end up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Opal — I’ll wait for Hana’s confirmation and then swing in late. Keep me posted if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye on the supplies for the repair drive, and I still need tape, spare screws, and any working wire. Rey’s looking for those too, so we should be set if he finds any.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds right. We’ll start with the broken door and the leaky faucet, keep the drop-off where it was planned, and handle the smaller fixes after.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring the drill, hammer, wrench sets, duct tape, and ladder for the repair drive. If you need the rest, I can have everything there by 4 this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Gus — thank you. Once Sam’s set, we’ll get you started on the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll be there with everything by 4 if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday at the community center still works for me. Keep it low-key, and I can handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll start knocking on doors this afternoon so folks know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. If you can, ask Dane to come by late and sort the donations, and maybe have Rey look for tape and spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Has Hana confirmed whether we need a ladder for the repair drive? If so, I can ask Gus to bring his tools around 4.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I haven’t heard a yes on the ladder yet, so I’d rather confirm the timing and drop-off first. Once that’s set, I can help make sure the details go out to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, let’s confirm the timing and drop-off first. Once Hana answers on the ladder, I’ll handle Gus around 4.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Still just a rumor on my end, but I’ll ask around and let you and Faye know if I hear a start date or anything solid. Nell said she’ll pass along any real details too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — I’m still waiting on confirmed timing and drop-off details before I count on anything. If you hear something solid, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as anything solid comes in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, Uli — Sunday at the community center it is, and I’ll keep it low-key. Thanks for handling the rest; I’ll keep coordinating the supplies and word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Ira. I’ll stay ready once Tess hears the start date and can help line things up around school schedules.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out for Quinn’s repair drive details while I’m out running errands, and I’ll let Oren know when I’m back.
